page.title: Account security
page.subtitle: Manage your account security: multi-factor authentication, sign-in history, signed-in devices and sessions.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.desc: With two-factor authentication enabled, signing in requires a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password, which helps prevent account theft.
twoFactor.recommend: Enable two-factor authentication to make your account safer
twoFactor.enabledNote: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Your account is better protected
twoFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator)
twoFactor.step2: Scan the QR code below with the app
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
twoFactor.backupDesc: Keep these recovery codes safe. If you cannot access your authenticator, you can sign in with one of them. Each code works only once.
twoFactor.enablePrompt: To confirm it is you, enter your password to enable two-factor authentication
twoFactor.disablePrompt: To confirm it is you, enter your password to disable two-factor authentication

sessions.title: Session management
sessions.desc: Manage your active sessions and revoke the ones you no longer need.
sessions.currentTip: This is the session you are using now. Token: {id}
sessions.cannotRevokeTip: The current session cannot be revoked
sessions.revokeOthersTip: Revoke every session except the current one
sessions.revokeAllTip: Warning: this revokes all sessions, including the current one!
sessions.confirmRevokeOthers: Revoke all sessions except the current one?
sessions.confirmRevokeAll: Revoke all sessions, including the current one?

flow.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
flow.enabledSuccess: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Keep your backup codes safe
